title: Harry Lipsette Farm, Lower Brighton
description: Harry Lipsette Farm, Lower Brighton. These farms were nearly self-sufficient; they raised chickens for eggs, cows for milk and butter, pigs for meat, and sheep for wool. In addition, gardens were abundant with beans, carrots, cabbage, onions, and preserves, providing enough to sustain a household through winter.
